facts.business: Mukta Agriculture Limited is an Indian listed company with significant exposure to group entities through investments, loans, advances, and trade receivables, which constitute the majority of its total assets.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter regarding exposure in group entities and recoverability of intercompany receivables dependent on future cash flows and management judgement
